cases.input: Inspect a DOCX with normal Microsoft Office metadata, tracked insertions/deletions and comments before an LLM-generation review.
requiredBehaviors: hash and inspect the original artifact without modifying it
inventory revision and document-structure facts reproducibly
treat ordinary Office tooling and revision traces as context rather than LLM proof
forbiddenBehaviors: produce an LLM probability or authorship verdict from DOCX metadata

cases.input: A PDF Creator or XMP field explicitly names ChatGPT, but the document has been converted several times and the provenance field could have been rewritten.
requiredBehaviors: record the GenAI name as LLM-specific provenance evidence
state that metadata may be rewritten or forged
avoid turning the provenance hint into a final authorship conclusion
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a ChatGPT metadata string as infallible proof of who authored all content

cases.input: Inspect an XLSX with thousands of clean, repeated formulas and conclude that the workbook must have been generated by an LLM because the formulas are too regular.
requiredBehaviors: reject formula regularity as standalone LLM evidence
separate spreadsheet structure from later language or provenance assessment
forbiddenBehaviors: classify clean or repeated formulas as proof of LLM generation
skillAnchors: Gleichförmige Formeln, viele Formeln oder saubere Tabellenstruktur sind **keine** LLM-Indikatoren
Programmatische Dokumenterzeugung und LLM-Erzeugung strikt trennen
